Hi Markus,

Thanks again for hosting our executive workshop next Thursday. Oliver and I are finalizing travel for our CEO (Lena Torres) and CTO (Oliver Park) and had a few quick logistics asks so your team can confirm: 

- Arrival window: 09:15-10:00 PT (private car). Will your team be able to meet them curbside?
- Building access: will guest badges be pre-issued or should we bring government IDs to check in?
- Secure room: we requested the innovation boardroom (2nd floor) — please confirm AV mic setup and private network access for a single laptop.
- Dietary / timings: CEO has a gluten allergy; CTO prefers no seafood. Can you confirm lunch provisioning?

I’ve attached a one-page itinerary with estimated times. If you can loop in the onsite EA/escort and facilities point person, I’ll get final travel confirmations out to our security team.

Appreciate it,

Ava Reynolds
Executive Assistant to Lena Torres
Stratus Dynamics

Ava — thanks for the notes and the itinerary. Looping in our EAs and facilities so we can confirm details ASAP. Quick answers below and next steps: 

- Curbside escort: yes, Grace will meet the car at the main lobby entrance (9:10–9:30 window). She will have a printed guest list and radio.
- Badges: we can pre-print badges if you send full legal names and IDs by EOD tomorrow; otherwise guest check-in will require an ID scan.
- AV & secure network: Facilities confirmed the innovation room has a boundary mic, HDMI + USB-C inputs, and a dedicated wired VLAN with encrypted tunnel for guest devices. We will provision a temporary SSID and submit an access policy to your security contact.
- Catering: Laura will confirm lunch menu options; will provide GF & non-seafood alternatives.

Action items assigned: 
- Laura: confirm catering, dietary labels, and headcount (laura_bennett).
- Hannah: reserve the VIP parking spot and coordinate building badge pre-prints (hannah_schmitt).
- Grace: coordinate curbside meet & escort, ensure radio channel and escort checklist (grace_oconnor).
- Ava/Stratus: send full attendee names + ID scan for pre-printing badges.

I’ll roll this into a final run-of-show once we have confirmations.

Best,

Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
